_comment: Creatures, villagers, quests and named creatures. Edit this file to change names, dialogue, rewards, monster strength and what monsters do; no recompiling needed. The game reads assets/content.json next to the program if it exists, otherwise the copy built into it. The ids (Goblin, Elder, Slay_Grishnak, ...) must match the enums in the source; each creature's 'behaviours' are tried in the order listed, and each name is a capability implemented in behaviour.odin.

npcs.name: Elder Mara
npcs.idle_line: You have done more than enough. Rest a while.

npcs.name: Tomas the smith
npcs.idle_line: The forge is hot, but I've nothing for you now.

npcs.name: Yara the hunter
npcs.idle_line: The deep places have their own laws. Learn them, or die.

npcs.name: Sister Wren
npcs.idle_line: The Light does not reach past the third depth. Carry a torch, and faith.

npcs.name: Captain Aldric
npcs.idle_line: Keep the road clear, and I'll keep the gate open.

quests.title: Slay Grishnak (depth 2)
offer: Grishnak, a goblin warlord, raids us from
the second depth. Our fields burn.
Slay him, and you'll have gold, and
the chain shirt my son once wore.
quests.reminder: Grishnak still lives. Depth 2, adventurer.
thanks: Grishnak is dead? The village owes you.
Take these, as promised.

quests.title: Bring Tomas a spiked club
offer: Ogres carry clubs studded with old iron.
Bring me one in your backpack, and I'll
reforge the nails into a proper blade.
quests.reminder: No club yet? The ogres below carry them.
thanks: Ha! Good iron under all that rust.
Here: a longsword, as promised.

quests.title: Slay Gorluk (depth 4)
offer: With Grishnak gone, Gorluk the ogre
chieftain gathers the tribes at depth 4.
End him, and songs will be sung of you.
quests.reminder: Gorluk waits at depth 4.
thanks: Gorluk is dead. The songs begin tonight.
This is all the gold we could gather.

quests.title: Bring the elder a healing potion
offer: The village stores run thin on healing potion.
If you find one down there, bring it back
and we'll see you're rewarded for it.
quests.reminder: Still need that healing potion, if you find one.
thanks: That'll do nicely, thank you.
Please, take this for your trouble.

quests.title: Slay Korrath (depth 29)
offer: A golem has woken in the deep dark,
depth 29, stone given cruel purpose.
End it, and the village will finally
believe the depths can be tamed.
quests.reminder: Korrath still stands, depth 29. Stone doesn't tire.
thanks: Korrath, broken at last. Rubble now.
You've more than earned this, truly.

quests.title: Slay Vaelor (depth 30)
offer: Vaelor was a smith too, once, before
the depths remade him into bone and
rust at depth 30. Put him down, and
bring back what's left of his craft.
quests.reminder: Vaelor waits at depth 30, still swinging that ruined blade.
thanks: So the old smith finally rests. Good.
Take this. He'd have wanted you to.

quests.title: Slay Mossback (depth 31)
offer: Mossback has haunted depth 31 longer
than I've hunted. Moss-backed, ancient,
and mean. Bring it down, and I'll call
my hunting done for good.
quests.reminder: Mossback's still out there, depth 31. Old and vicious.
thanks: Ha! The old beast finally fell.
This is the last bounty I'll ever pay.

quests.title: Slay Sorrow (depth 32)
offer: Something grieves at depth 32, and its
grief has teeth. Sorrow, the whispering
dead call it. Silence it, and bring
back proof so it may finally rest.
quests.reminder: Sorrow still weeps and kills at depth 32. It must be silenced.
thanks: Sorrow is quiet now. At peace, I hope.
Take this. The Light remembers kindness.

quests.title: Slay Aurek (depth 33)
offer: Aurek, the Last Sentinel, guards depth
33 for a war long since lost. It will
kill anything that passes. End it, and
the bounty's the largest I've ever posted.
quests.reminder: Aurek still guards depth 33. Biggest bounty on my board.
thanks: Aurek down. I didn't think anyone could.
Full bounty, and my respect besides.

items.name: Gold
items.flavor: Goblins love it. So do you.

items.name: Healing potion
items.flavor: Tastes of cherries and iron.

items.name: Short sword
items.flavor: Plain and reliable.

items.name: Goblin dagger
items.flavor: Crude, but it bites.

items.name: Spiked club
items.flavor: Pried from an ogre's fingers.

items.name: Longsword
items.flavor: Balanced, keen, old.

items.name: Leather armor
items.flavor: Stiff, but it turns a blade.

items.name: Chain shirt
items.flavor: Heavy rings, carefully mended.

items.name: Scroll of Town Portal
items.flavor: The ink is still faintly warm.

items.name: Skreel's ear
items.flavor: Still warm. Someone will want proof.

items.name: Dunmarr's fang
items.flavor: Yellowed and cracked, but unmistakably his.

items.name: Ashka's tusk
items.flavor: Carved with crude, boastful runes.

items.name: Blackmaw's claw
items.flavor: Long enough to open a man from throat to belt.

items.name: Threk's skull
items.flavor: Heavier than it looks. So was he.

items.name: Rusk's ear
items.flavor: Notched from a hundred old fights.

items.name: Gnarl's fang
items.flavor: Rimmed black with old poison.

items.name: Kroll's tusk
items.flavor: Chipped where it met the anvil.

items.name: Fenrik's claw
items.flavor: Iron-hard, and just as sharp.

items.name: Molgar's skull
items.flavor: The jaw alone could crush a shield.

items.name: Snitch's ear
items.flavor: Pierced with a dozen stolen rings.

items.name: Marrow's fang
items.flavor: Filed to a wicked point.

items.name: Grendle's tusk
items.flavor: Slick with bog-water, even now.

items.name: Karth's claw
items.flavor: Still stained dark at the tip.

items.name: The Hollow Fang's skull
items.flavor: Its eye sockets never seem to close.

items.name: Vex's ear
items.flavor: A cursed sigil is scratched behind it.

items.name: Morrow's fang
items.flavor: Cold to the touch, even in your pocket.

items.name: Ghurn's tusk
items.flavor: Blighted black at the root.

items.name: Sable's claw
items.flavor: Darker than any natural shadow.

items.name: Uldrath's skull
items.flavor: It seems to watch you from the backpack.

items.name: Pike's ear
items.flavor: A thief's mark is tattooed on it.

items.name: Grix's fang
items.flavor: Bloodied from one blow too many.

items.name: Bruundor's tusk
items.flavor: Thick enough to use as a club itself.

items.name: Vozgar's claw
items.flavor: Curved like a reaper's blade.

items.name: Warlord Krenn's skull
items.flavor: Crowned still with a dented iron circlet.

items.name: Hand axe
items.flavor: A woodsman's axe, better suited to war than wood.

items.name: Mace
items.flavor: Blunt, honest, and hard to parry.

items.name: War hammer
items.flavor: Two hands, one devastating idea.

items.name: Spear
items.flavor: Keeps something dangerous at a distance.

items.name: Rapier
items.flavor: Quick, precise, made for the riposte.

items.name: Wooden shield
items.flavor: A merchant's leftover stock, better than nothing.

items.name: Helmet
items.flavor: Iron over your skull; the rest you trust to speed.

items.name: Antidote
items.flavor: Bitter and medicinal. Steadies whatever ails you.

items.name: Korrath's charm
items.flavor: Carved bone, still warm from the stone that wore it.

items.name: Vaelor's charm
items.flavor: Strung on old cord, the knots tied by a smith's hands.

items.name: Mossback's charm
items.flavor: Slick with moss, ancient long before you were born.

items.name: Sorrow's charm
items.flavor: It doesn't feel like bone anymore. It feels like grief.

items.name: Aurek's charm
items.flavor: The rune on it is still faintly warm to the touch.
